name: Real-time rendering via mesh extraction and feature aggregation
definition: A rendering acceleration technique that replaces slow neural volume rendering with a mesh-based approach by pre-computing appearance features and using a compact shape model for real-time frame generation.
summary: Real-time rendering via mesh extraction and feature aggregation accelerates neural volume rendering by replacing slow volumetric integration with a mesh-based approach that pre-computes appearance features and uses a compact shape model for real-time frame generation.
